text:
rachel: heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window for rack `edge-tor-4` next Mon 01:30 UTC (90m). Purpose: coordinated NIC driver reset on compute hosts + graceful ToR uplink pacing to mitigate recent packet drops. This is a targeted network hygiene job, not a full host reboot.

rachel: impact: briefly increased packet loss during the NIC reset (anticipated ~10-30s per host), transient RPS throttles on client-facing proxies may occur. Inference serving should stay online; new connections may retry.

dmitri: Do we include dedicated/reserved pools? any model rollouts overlapping?

rachel: scope: ephemeral + preemptible compute in edge-us-west only. Dedicated/reserved pools are excluded and pinned routing remains. No scheduled model rollouts during the window. We'll tag ticket `dedicated-safe` and `edge-only`.

izzy: ops plan: cohorts of 8 hosts, 8m stagger between cohorts, NIC-reset command is non-disruptive but we will do health checks. After each cohort run a short TCP storm probe and kv-cache preseed. Abort if packet loss >2% for 5m or >5% pod restarts in affected cohort.

izzy: runbook snippet:
```
net-cordon --rack edge-tor-4 --cohort 8
nic-reset --driver igb_uio --grace 30
tcp-probe --duration 180 --rate 200
kvcache-seed --delay 300
net-verify --checks packetloss,pod-restarts
```

omar: cost note: if scheduler backfills to other regions we might see temporary cross-region control-plane RPCs and spot bursts. Estimate worst-case extra egress ~2k calls and ~$250 in spot churn. Calling it out in comms.

claire: Support: prepping status page text and PSAT. We'll send 4h pre-alert to customers in affected edge regions and include clear note: "Dedicated capacity unaffected; possible brief throttles to new connections".

ben: SRE: I'll run a preflight tomorrow under 70% load and post results. I'll own the canary and escalation steps. If we see >1 leader election in control-plane or p95 API > 500ms we'll pause.

rachel: good. Canary plan: run synthetic TCP+API probes 30m before window for 20m. If p95 API < 300ms and packet loss <0.5% we proceed. If packet loss 0.5-2% proceed with extra observation window. If >2% abort.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4127 created and scheduled. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/network-nic-reset. Paging group: eng-infra-oncall.

dmitri: Who's on-call for the window and who will own rollback?

ben: ACK (sre). I'll be on-call. Rollback plan: `nic-rollback --rack edge-tor-4` and re-enable normal uplink pacing. Also `route-sticky --enable` to pin traffic to local compute if we see cross-region spill.

claire: ACK (support). Status page and PSAT queued.

omar: tagging cost and post-op report in ticket. We'll run a delta-cost after ops.

rachel: final check: izzy (ops), ben (sre), claire (support), dmitri (infra). Any objections?

izzy: ack (ops) 6a7. automation ready to run cohorts.

ben: ack (sre). I'll post preflight link 2h before.

dmitri: ack (infra).

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4127 state -> scheduled. Notifying eng-infra-oncall.

rachel: thanks all 44d. I'll post a short post-op summary and include the cost delta and runbook changes within 24h after completion. Ping here if anything changes.
